data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of $169.1m (2013: favourable run off deviation of $129.9m) was experienced during the year in respect of various lines of business, most significantly within aviation ($12.4m), marine ($21.7m), liability ($62.6m) and reinsurance ($60.1m). This is mainly due to a reduction in the ultimate loss estimates.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a favourable prior-accident-year run-off deviation of $169.1m in 2014 (a release), driven principally by reductions in ultimate loss estimates. The release was reported across several lines, most notably Aviation, Marine, Liability and Reinsurance, and materially improved the underwriting result for the year.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development sourced from Note 5 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a gross favourable run-off deviation of $169.1m (explicit gross figure). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (prior year comparative column). The report also notes a RITC of $2,055m from 2012 and prior into 2013 which could distort some development tables/triangles (no triangle present in provided pages). All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
